sourceFile: BRS 161014S08ZZ Reliability Test result for dome 8.11.2023_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable because it misidentifies the changed factor and treats header/raw-data rows as outcomes.
issues: Changed factor is filename instead of reliability stress conditions.
Baseline/test grouping is not established as before vs after per test item.
Many outcomes are header-derived or frequency-row artifacts, not valid metrics.
PASS/NG summary rows and sample result rows are underused.
Load duration conflicts between overview and detail sheet.
requiredUserQuestions: Should load test duration follow the summary row or detail sheet?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factors as reliability test conditions by sheet or report context.
Use before/after as baseline/test condition for each stress item.
Keep SPL, impedance, F0, THD and PASS/NG as outcomes only.
Cite condition rows plus actual result rows, especially summary PASS/NG rows.
Remove raw header statistics and invalid specs such as '>4'.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient because cited rows are mostly headers, not final evidence.
